name: coal
what: a lump of coal: a chunky faceted lump of deep glossy black-brown (the darkest shade of its own brown, never pure black) with bright blue-grey glints along its upper-left facet edges, strong contrast, centred with 3-5 px of padding

name: gunpowder
what: a small heap of gunpowder: a soft cone of near-black charcoal-grey grains with clearly lighter grey and a few sulphur-yellow specks, a light top-left side and a dark lower-right side, strong contrast, centred with 3-5 px of padding

name: stick
what: a wooden stick: a slightly crooked warm-brown twig a full 3 px thick from end to end, with grain, a small knot and a lighter top edge, lying diagonally, handle at the bottom left, tip at the top right, filling the canvas corner to corner

name: wood_hoe
what: a wooden hoe: a long plain wooden handle and, across its top end, one thin flat blade like a garden hoe, about a third of the canvas wide and only 3 px thick, set at a right angle to the handle and bent downward, made of warm orange-brown carved wood; not a hammer, no block-shaped head, lying diagonally, handle at the bottom left, tip at the top right, filling the canvas corner to corner

name: stone_hoe
what: a stone hoe: a long plain wooden handle and, across its top end, one thin flat blade like a garden hoe, about a third of the canvas wide and only 3 px thick, set at a right angle to the handle and bent downward, made of chipped warm grey-tan stone bound with cream cord; not a hammer, no block-shaped head, lying diagonally, handle at the bottom left, tip at the top right, filling the canvas corner to corner

name: diamond_hoe
what: a diamond hoe: a long plain leather-wrapped handle and, across its top end, one thin flat blade like a garden hoe, about a third of the canvas wide and only 3 px thick, set at a right angle to the handle and bent downward, made of faceted cyan diamond with white facet tips; not a hammer, no block-shaped head, lying diagonally, handle at the bottom left, tip at the top right, filling the canvas corner to corner

name: venison
what: raw venison: a lean deep dark-red steak with a clear darker red-brown outline, a thin cream fat edge and soft marbling, glossy highlight on the upper left, centred with 3-5 px of padding

name: spider_eye
what: a spider eye: a glossy dark red eyeball seen from the front, a big black slit pupil in an amber iris, a white glint on the upper left and a few thin dark red veins, clearly an eye, centred with 3-5 px of padding

name: kibble
what: a small sack of kibble: a tied cream-tan burlap sack, open at the top showing round brown pet-food pellets, a few pellets spilled in front, centred with 3-5 px of padding

name: hare
what: a raw hare: a whole skinned hare carcass lying diagonally, head at the top right with long ears laid back, long hind legs at the bottom left, dark red meat with a clear outline, reading as a hare

name: cooked_beef
what: a cooked steak: a warm rich brown seared steak with darker brown grill stripes, a crisp golden fat edge and a glossy highlight, never grey, centred with 3-5 px of padding
